name: docker_ops
description: Manage pai-stack Docker containers via Docker socket. Logs every action to /app/logs/docker-ops.log. Allowed actions: list, status, logs, restart, start, stop, exec.

service.description: Target container name. Required for all actions except 'list'.

lines.description: Log lines to tail (for 'logs' only). Default: 50. Max: 500.

cmd.description: Command to run inside the container (for 'exec' only). Runs via sh -c.
